name: Keyboard Trainer
summary: A desktop-first typing game for children aged 6–12: ten keyboard challenges of increasing difficulty, with stars, XP and coins to earn on the way. Progress is stored only in the browser.

cover.alt: Keyboard Trainer start screen: the KeyQuest title, the line “Turn every key into an adventure.”, a Play now button and a block-built character on a floating island.
cover.caption: Start screen

figures.alt: Level 1, “Home Row Hello”: the letter A glows above an on-screen keyboard, with combo, accuracy and mistake counters.
figures.caption: Level 1 — Home Row Hello

missing: Confirmed product name (the app currently shows the working title KeyQuest)
